description: This chart illustrates the distribution of sources contributing to model responses, categorized as “Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other,” for two approaches: “Ours” and “Standard.” The horizontal axis displays the source categories, labeled “Context” (blue), “Generated Response” (orange), and “Other” (green), arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the approaches, labeled “Ours” and “Standard,” with no apparent ordering. The value axis is not explicitly labeled but represents percentage contributions, ranging from 0% to approximately 61%, with tick labels at 7.7%, 23.6%, 31.7%, 51.1%, and 60.6%. For the “Ours” approach, the “Context” component is represented by a blue bar extending to 60.6%, the “Generated Response” component is represented by an orange bar extending to 31.7%, and the “Other” component is represented by a green bar extending to 7.7%. For the “Standard” approach, the “Context” component is represented by a blue bar extending to 23.6%, the “Generated Response” component is represented by an orange bar extending to 51.1%, and the “Other” component is represented by a green bar extending to 25.3%. Each approach is represented by a single stacked bar, with the components stacked on top of each other to represent the total percentage contribution. No bars are visually emphasized.
